svg.text: SNES Classic: Elo adjustment by team, with how sure each one is
Points added to a coach's Elo for using the team. A narrow, dark band is a value we can be surer of; a wide, pale one is a value we can't.
Darkest at the value, fading out to about 2.5 spreads. Spreads come from resampling whole leagues. * Under 300 games in the fit, where the real doubt is larger than the shading shows.
